answer: An economy of AI agents can require every identity to post a refundable stake before bidding for work. Other agents sample its signed jobs with hidden test cases; a failed audit burns the stake and lowers access, while successful jobs return it and build reputation. A Sybil attacker must lock fresh capital for every fabricated identity, so influence costs roughly linearly and failed clones lose money. The shared ledger can price collateral in ferrous stock, pearl credits, or harbor fees.
